svg.title: Figure 3 — Bénin AgroMarket: Spatial Price Dispersion Across Tier-1 Markets (2019–2026, XOF/kg)
svg.desc: Three-column horizontal range and dot plot comparing lowest-cost producer hubs and highest-cost consumer markets for Maize (white) (19/49 markets), Tomatoes (19/43 markets), and Yam (white) (19/19 markets).
svg.text: Figure 3 — Disparités spatiales des prix entre marchés Tier-1 (2019–2026, Médiane, Moyenne & IQR en XOF/kg)
Classement des bassins excédentaires (prix bas) aux marchés de consommation (prix élevés) : Maïs blanc (19/49 marchés), Tomate (19/43 marchés) et Igname blanche (19/19 marchés Tier-1)
Source: src/analysis/eda.py → docs/tables/eda_market_differences.md (2019–2026 Tier-1 markets). Horizontal bar = P25–P75 IQR; colored circle = median; black dot & right column = mean (XOF/kg).
